title: Skill Bash
wikitext: Classes: CLR, PAL, SHD, WAR Autoskill: Yes This ability uses a shield to bash your current target, giving a chance to stun. The AC of the shield impacts the damage amount. Bash will double and triple attack based on your skill. Macro command: /doability Bash Large races (Ogre, Troll, Barbarian) gain access to the related ability [[Slam]], which can be used without a shield. If you do have a shield equipped and possess the Bash skill, Slam will use the shield's AC when calculating damage.
